titleEn: Find the Winner of an Array Game
title: 找出数组游戏的赢家
summary: 首两数比较，大者留在数组首、小者移到末尾；某值连续赢 k 次即获胜，返回赢家。
insight: 无需维护队列；当前擂主与后续元素按原顺序比赛。新擂主胜场置一，旧擂主获胜则累加；数组最大值成为擂主后永不失败。
pitfalls: 新擂主击败旧擂主算第一次连胜
k 可能大于数组长度

solutions.title: 流式擂主模拟
solutions.idea: 顺序挑战当前冠军并记录连续胜场。
steps: 从 i=1 扫描；champion>arr[i] 则 wins++，否则 champion=arr[i],wins=1
wins==k 时返回 champion；扫描结束返回 champion

code.java: class Solution { public int getWinner(int[] arr,int k){int champion=arr[0],wins=0;for(int i=1;i<arr.length;i++){if(champion>arr[i])wins++;else{champion=arr[i];wins=1;}if(wins==k)return champion;}return champion;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun getWinner(arr:IntArray,k:Int):Int{var champion=arr[0];var wins=0;for(i in 1 until arr.size){if(champion>arr[i])wins++ else{champion=arr[i];wins=1};if(wins==k)return champion};return champion} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int getWinner(vector<int>& arr,int k){int champion=arr[0],wins=0;for(int i=1;i<(int)arr.size();++i){if(champion>arr[i])++wins;else{champion=arr[i];wins=1;}if(wins==k)return champion;}return champion;} };
